items.title: Fully Funded Workshop Scholarship in Germany 2026
items.one_liner: A fully funded workshop scholarship in Germany is offered for PhD students from Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
items.why: Provides a direct funding and networking opportunity for a Global South-focused PhD researcher to train in Germany.
items.action: Check application deadlines and eligibility criteria for the workshop scholarship.

items.title: Researchers Ground Urban DNA Framework in Evolutionary Theories
items.one_liner: Researchers published a study grounding the 'urban DNA' framework in regulation and niche evolutionary theories.
items.why: Offers foundational theoretical perspectives on urban development, settlement morphology, and systems theory.
items.action: Read the study to evaluate its applicability to modeling land-cover change and urban form.

items.title: Philanthropy Funding for Cities' Climate Finance Prep Work
items.one_liner: A report discusses why philanthropy must fund preparatory work for urban climate finance initiatives.
items.why: Highlights financial bottlenecks in climate adaptation planning for cities, tying into environmental governance.
items.action: Read the analysis to understand pre-investment requirements for municipal climate planning.

items.title: Landscape Architects to Push for Local Climate Adaptation at COP31
items.one_liner: Landscape architects are preparing to advocate for greater local climate adaptation investment at COP31.
items.why: Connects landscape architecture and green-blue infrastructure strategies directly to international policy frameworks.
items.action: Track COP31 positioning documents regarding local-level green infrastructure investments.

items.title: Exploring Opposition to Urban Climate Action ('Urban Greenlash')
items.one_liner: Reports examine the rising public and political opposition facing urban climate and greening actions.
items.why: Informs research on environmental justice, governance hurdles, and trade-offs in urban greening projects.
items.action: Incorporate stakeholder resistance dynamics into frameworks assessing urban green-blue infrastructure.

items.title: UNEP Warns Developing Countries Need $305bn Annually by 2035
items.one_liner: UNEP warns that developing countries will require $305 billion annually by 2035 for climate adaptation.
items.why: Supplies benchmark financial figures for urban and regional adaptation deficits across the Global South.
items.action: Note the UNEP adaptation cost projections for inclusion in the literature review background.

items.title: Earth–Brain–Health Commission Links Urban Change to Mental Health
items.one_liner: The Earth–Brain–Health Commission released findings linking climate and urban change to human mental health outcomes.
items.why: Expands on human benefits of urban environments, connecting to ecosystem service delivery and human well-being.
items.action: Review the commission's findings to incorporate mental health metrics into human benefit assessments.

items.title: UN Warns COP30 Adaptation Pledge Falls Short for Poorer Nations
items.one_liner: The UN warns that existing COP30 adaptation pledges meet under a third of developing nations' needs.
items.why: Contextualizes the macroeconomic and governance constraints facing climate adaptation in the Global South.
items.action: Review UN adaptation gap estimates to support the rationale for international climate finance studies.

items.title: Urban and Municipal Development Fund by AfDB
items.one_liner: The African Development Bank Group highlights its Urban and Municipal Development Fund for urban projects.
items.why: Provides insights into financing mechanisms and municipal development projects relevant to the Global South.
items.action: Explore project templates and financing criteria used by the fund for urban planning.

items.title: Brazil’s Data-Driven Plan for Climate-Resilient Healthcare
items.one_liner: Brazil introduced a data-driven planning approach aimed at building climate-resilient healthcare systems.
items.why: Provides a Global South case study on utilizing spatial data and evidence for climate adaptation planning.
items.action: Examine the methodologies used in Brazil's data-driven framework for transferability.

items.title: Master of Science in Climate Change Validated in South Sudan
items.one_liner: UNDP, the University of Juba, and the Ministry of Environment validated a new Master of Science program.
items.why: Reflects capacity building and institutional strengthening for climate expertise within a fragile setting.
items.action: Observe curriculum structures used for capacity building in data-scarce and conflict-affected contexts.

items.title: Telangana Space Policy Planned for 2027 in Hyderabad
items.one_liner: Hyderabad has announced plans for a regional space policy slated for 2027 in Telangana.
items.why: Demonstrates regional integration of remote sensing and spatial data policies in a Global South urban setting.
items.action: Monitor the policy's development for potential implications on regional spatial modeling access.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
